From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Ben — quick inline notes below. Forwarding with suggested edits in the attached aws_listing_draft.md (tracked).

> "Enterprise features — region-aware routing"
On Mon, Jan 12, 2026 at 10:10 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com> wrote:
> Laura: can you check the 3rd bullet under "Enterprise features" — I think "region-aware routing" is overstated; maybe "region-aware deployment options" is safer.

Agree — change to: "Region-aware deployment and routing policies" which keeps the capability but avoids implying a managed cross-region network. Also: 
- Replace "zero-downtime rolling updates" with "rolling updates with configurable fallback" (less absolute).
- For co-sell SEO: include keywords "dedicated GPU inference", "LLM inference SaaS", "model serving runtime" in the short description (don't stuff, but include naturally).

Security phrasing: per legal we must avoid claims like "encrypted end-to-end by default" without referencing KMS/HSM. Suggest: "Supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and audit logs for enterprise compliance."

Vanessa — pricing: the pricing_matrix_v2 has both hourly and token-based rows. AWS offer page requires consistent units — recommend presenting primary price as "per vCPU-hour (dedicated) / per 1k tokens (hosted)" and include footnote: "Contact partner for committed capacity pricing."

I'll be on the call Wed 9:30am PT.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Marketing | Redwood Inference

Subject: AWS marketplace listing — feature callouts & co-sell optics (final edits & next steps)

Alice — thanks for the draft and for being flexible on timing. Attached are the edited copy and a lean pricing matrix (aws_listing_draft.md, pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx). Changes we made: 
- Short one-liner (<=110 chars): "Redwood Inference — high-throughput, cost-aware LLM serving for production apps."
- Short description (for SKU): included key terms: dedicated GPU inference, model serving runtime, caching & batching.
- Feature bullets: adjusted as discussed ("Region-aware deployment and routing policies", "Rolling updates with configurable fallback").
- Security: replaced absolute claims with: "Supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and provides audit logs for compliance."
- Pricing: primary units called out with a footnote to contact partner for committed capacity/discounts.

Next steps:
1) Vanessa will verify AWS-specific SKU formatting and confirm whether the file needs an AMI/manifest.
2) Alice/ BrightLaunch to provide logo assets and partner contact point for co-sell activation (we need the Partner account ID).
3) If all good, Vanessa will submit the preview to the AWS marketplace console by Jan 18 so we can publish Jan 20.

Proposed sync Wed Jan 13 9:30am PT — calendar invite included (let me know if you need a different time).
